content.text: In regions where platforms like Stripe or PayPal block transactions, deploying a functional digital store can feel impossible. Countries such as Nigeria, Ghana, and Venezuela face significant barriers that hinder digital creators from monetizing their work. COREMERCH provides a solution through sovereign commerce stacks. This guide will walk you through deploying a digital store using Cloudflare Pages—completely free of charge and without reliance on traditional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-options-ethiopian-digital-creators-honest-side-side-4|payment]] systems.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Traditional payment platforms often exclude creators in developing regions, leaving them unable to collect [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/tron-usdt-payments-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-13|Tron USDT]] for digital products. The infrastructure provided by COREMERCH eliminates this barrier by leveraging decentralized payment methods and open-source technologies. You gain full ownership of your store, ensuring that you are not reliant on external platforms that may restrict your access. This approach allows you to operate freely, maintaining control over your transactions and customer data.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To begin deployment, gather your digital products and ensure they are ready for delivery. You will need a Cloudflare account to utilize Cloudflare Pages, and you should familiarize yourself with Google Apps Script for backend setup. Additionally, prepare your crypto wallet for integration with NOWPayments, which will handle your transactions. Collecting these resources beforehand streamlines the deployment process, allowing you to focus on setting up your store efficiently.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

With your resources in place, you can start configuring your payment and delivery pipeline. Set up Cloudflare Pages to host your digital store's frontend, ensuring that your products are showcased clearly. Next, use Google Apps Script to facilitate the backend logic, connecting your store with NOWPayments to manage crypto transactions. This configuration allows for automatic payment verification and seamless delivery of digital products upon successful transactions, creating a smooth experience for your customers.
You own everything—no platform dependency.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is configured, you can initiate a live test of your store. Launch Cloudflare Pages and ensure that all pages are functioning as expected. Conduct a test transaction using a small amount of cryptocurrency to verify that NOWPayments processes the payment seamlessly. Confirm that your digital products are delivered automatically after the transaction completes. This step is crucial for identifying any potential issues before fully promoting your store.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After your digital store is live and functioning, consider how to scale your offerings. You can expand the number of products or services you offer and enhance your marketing efforts to reach a broader audience. Using the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) allows for additional features such as SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration, ensuring that your communications are trustworthy. Continuous monitoring and optimization of your store will lead to sustained growth as you attract more customers.

The [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-difference-between-choices-payment-methods-filipino-digital-4|COREMERCH guide to difference]] between Stack 01 and Stack 02 is not which one works — both work — it is which one fits your situation. Stack 01 is the right choice if you want to deploy yourself, you are comfortable with Google Workspace tools, and your initial volume is under 100 orders per day. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete Stack 01 build with full source code and step-by-step configuration. Stack 02 is the right choice if you want the deployment done for you, you need higher volume capacity, or you want email deliverability infrastructure configured from day one. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy Stack 02 under your accounts in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Seamless crypto payments with instant product delivery.

The setup decision comes down to time versus depth. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything to build Stack 01 yourself in an afternoon or Stack 02 over a weekend — full source code, step-by-step configuration, and the NOWPayments integration guide. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH build Stack 02 for you in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC configured for email deliverability. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. Both are at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Read the Sovereign Blueprint before you start configuring anything — understanding the complete architecture before touching any settings prevents the most common configuration mistakes. Create all required accounts first: NOWPayments, Cloudflare or GitHub, Supabase or Google account, Resend or Gmail. Then configure the backend with all credentials before deploying it. Then deploy the backend and confirm the endpoint is live. Then configure NOWPayments with the endpoint URL. Then build and deploy the storefront. Then configure your custom domain if using one. Then run the mainnet test. Then check the order database. Then — and only then — share the URL. The sequence is not arbitrary. Each step depends on the previous one.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

You can build a digital store for free by using Cloudflare Pages for hosting and integrating NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions. This setup allows you to maintain full control over your store without relying on traditional payment platforms.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 utilizes GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script for deployment, while Stack 02 leverages Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase. Stack 02, deployed in 48 hours, offers enhanced features and is end-to-end tested for performance.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages provide reliable hosting solutions for digital product stores. However, Cloudflare Pages offers more advanced integration options with backend services like Workers and Supabase.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept with NOWPayments?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to cater to a diverse customer base. This flexibility enables you to accept a wide range of digital currencies for your products.
How long does it take to deploy Stack 01?
Deploying Stack 01 typically takes between 4 to 6 hours following the Sovereign Blueprint. This quick turnaround allows you to get your digital store up and running in a short period.
